backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the Pristine Learning backend, combining authorization, blob storage, Stripe payment integration, user/teacher profile management, and album management into a single canister.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report confirming that the SubscriptionPackagesPage was updated to display 'Unlimited Sessions' for the Premium tier, with high confidence and a reference to test REQ-34.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Auto-generated JSON document summarizing each frontend source file's purpose and key changes, serving as a build/change reference for the frontend codebase.
frontend/index.css: Root Tailwind CSS entry point defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for the light and dark theme color system used throughout the application.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Vite/React app, setting the page title to 'Pristine Learning' and mounting the React root at the #root div.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that configures TanStack Router with all application routes, wraps the app in QueryClient, ThemeProvider, and LanguageProvider, and renders the shared RootLayout with Navbar, Footer, and Toaster.
frontend/src/components/BookingModal.tsx: Modal component for booking demo or paid sessions with a teacher, generating time slots for the next 5 days, saving bookings to local store, and dispatching notifications for both student and teacher.
Shared dashboard shell component providing a responsive sidebar with role-specific navigation items (admin, teacher, student), a notification bell, and a logout action.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Renders the site-wide footer with brand info, social links, quick navigation links, support links, and a contact email, using i18n translations and a UTM-tracked Caffeine.ai attribution link.
frontend/src/components/MessageInbox.tsx: Displays a two-panel messaging inbox showing the current user's conversations and messages, with polling via React Query and the ability to send new messages stored in a local store.
frontend/src/components/Navbar.tsx: Sticky top navigation bar with links to main routes, Internet Identity login/logout, a language switcher (EN/Tamil), and a responsive mobile menu.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal dialog shown to new users to collect their name and role (student or teacher), saves the profile to local store, generates a referral code, and redirects to the appropriate dashboard.
frontend/src/components/ReviewsSection.t: Displays a teacher's reviews with an aggregate star rating, per-star breakdown bar chart, and a list of individual review cards, polling for updates every 10 seconds.
frontend/src/components/ReviewSubmission: Form component that lets a student submit a star rating and optional text review for a completed booking, saving it to the local reviews store and invalidating related queries.
frontend/src/components/StripeSetupModal: A modal dialog component for configuring Stripe payment gateway, allowing users to enter a Stripe secret key and manage a list of allowed countries for payments.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: A React hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor using React Query, supporting both anonymous and authenticated (Internet Identity) usage, and invalidates dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context and hook using DFINITY's AuthClient, exposing login/logout functionality, identity state, and login status to React components.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Centralizes React Query hooks for backend interactions including user profiles, teacher profiles, and Stripe payment operations (configuration, checkout session creation, and status checks).
frontend/src/hooks/useTimezone.ts: A small hook that returns the user's local timezone and its abbreviation, memoized for performance.
frontend/src/i18n/en.ts: Contains the full English translation strings for the application, organized by feature area (navbar, footer, homepage, teacher search, etc.).
frontend/src/i18n/index.ts: Re-exports the English and Tamil translation objects and the TranslationKeys type from their respective modules.
frontend/src/i18n/LanguageContext.tsx: Provides a React context for language switching between English and Tamil, with localStorage persistence and a nested-key translation lookup function with English fallback.
frontend/src/i18n/ta.ts: Tamil (ta) language translation file for the Pristine Learning platform, containing localized strings for navbar, footer, homepage sections, and other UI components.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that imports fonts, sets up Tailwind directives, defines CSS custom properties for the teal+amber color palette (light and dark modes), and declares reusable component utility classes.
frontend/src/lib/localStore.ts: Client-side localStorage utility module defining TypeScript interfaces and CRUD helpers for bookings, notifications, messages, reviews, blog posts, subscriptions, wallet entries, withdrawals, and referral codes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React application entry point that mounts the app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider wrappers around the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboard.tsx: Admin dashboard page that displays platform analytics (revenue, bookings, teachers) and provides management interfaces for withdrawal approvals, subscription packages, blog posts, and referral codes.
AI Study Assistant page component that provides curriculum-specific study materials, quizzes, and study plans, with detailed pre-built content for Tamil Nadu Samacheer Kalvi subjects.
frontend/src/pages/BlogListingPage.tsx: Displays a grid of published blog posts fetched from the local store, with cover images, author/date metadata, and navigation to individual post pages.
frontend/src/pages/BlogPostPage.tsx: Renders a single blog post by slug with a simple line-by-line markdown parser, showing cover image, author, date, and content, with a 404 fallback if the post is not found.
frontend/src/pages/DemoPage.tsx: A multi-step interactive product tour page that walks users through key platform features (teacher search, profiles, dashboards, payments) using illustrated slides with forward/back navigation.
frontend/src/pages/Homepage.tsx: The main landing page featuring a hero section, platform stats, feature highlights, and a preview of featured teachers, with navigation to search and demo pages.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentFailure.tsx: A payment failure screen that reads an error message from URL params and provides buttons to retry the subscription flow or return home.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentSuccess.tsx: A payment success screen that verifies a Stripe session ID via the actor, saves the matched subscription to local store, and displays a confirmation or loading state accordingly.
frontend/src/pages/SessionRecordingsPage: Displays a student's completed session recordings, split into sessions with and without recording URLs, with playback links and a prompt to book if none exist.
frontend/src/pages/StudentDashboard.tsx: Student dashboard showing upcoming/completed bookings, pending reviews, subscription status, referral link, and a message inbox, with a profile setup gate for new users.
frontend/src/pages/SubscriptionPackagesP: Displays tiered subscription packages and handles checkout via Stripe (or a demo simulation), allowing logged-in users to subscribe to a tutoring plan.
frontend/src/pages/TeacherDashboard.tsx: Teacher dashboard showing bookings, earnings balance, demo slot creation, referral link, and a message inbox, with a profile setup gate for new users.
frontend/src/pages/TeacherProfilePage.ts: Public teacher profile page showing bio, ratings, available demo slots, reviews, and buttons to book a session or start a message conversation.
frontend/src/pages/TeacherSearchPage.tsx: A search and filter page for browsing teacher profiles, supporting filtering by name/subject, subject dropdown, language dropdown, and minimum rating. Displays results as cards with loading skeletons and error states.
frontend/src/pages/TeacherWalletPage.tsx: A teacher wallet dashboard page showing available balance, total earnings, pending withdrawals, and a transaction history table. Allows teachers to submit withdrawal requests via a dialog modal.
frontend/src/utils/formatTime.ts: Utility functions for formatting timestamps and dates into the user's local (or specified) timezone using the Intl API. Exports formatTime, formatDate, and getTimezoneAbbr helpers.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, persisting them to sessionStorage, and cleaning sensitive params from the URL hash without page reload.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with custom fonts, OKLCH-based semantic color tokens, border radii, box shadows, and keyframe animations (fade-in, slide-in, accordion). Includes typography, container-queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Project state manifest (version 21) describing the Pristine Learning tutoring marketplace architecture, existing features, known bugs, and tech stack decisions including Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Stripe/Razorpay, and bilingual i18n support.
